title: Fix focus workaround in skip-to-main-content a11y button
reason: The issue identifies a fixed 100ms focus timer after activating skip-to-main-content, but the only reply closes it without pursuing a change. This is a documented upstream accessibility workaround, not a confirmed defect resolution.

varveAssessment.assessment: No Varve skip-link focus behavior was inspected or reproduced from this report.

title: tldraw.com strips deployed source maps but keeps the sourceMappingURL comments, causing 404s and no devtools symbolication
reason: Describes a mismatch between Sentry source-map upload/deletion and deployed JavaScript comments in the upstream dotcom deployment. No discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This concerns upstream dotcom deployment and symbolication, not the Astro marketing site build.

title: Replace an image by pasting while cropping, fitting the new image to the frame centered
reason: Requests replacing an image in-place while crop mode preserves the frame and fits the new image. A comment says paste replacement was implemented in #9396 and asks whether the inverse copy-underlying-image operation should be supported separately.

varveAssessment.assessment: A useful crop-workflow comparison, but Varve support was not inspected or tested in this assessment.

title: Support snapping while cropping an image
reason: Requests crop-edge snapping to shape bounds and grid, respecting the user's snapping toggle/modifier and showing snap indicators. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is a concrete feature candidate; local crop snapping behavior and interaction contracts still need source inspection before promotion.

title: Support option+resize while cropping an image
reason: Requests holding Option/Alt while moving crop handles to resize the crop region symmetrically from its center, matching normal shape resize. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is a concrete interaction enhancement to compare with Varve crop controls; no local implementation or reproduction was inspected here.

title: cmd+enter while editing a shape's label can re-enter editing instead of exiting
reason: Describes a possible same-keypress re-entry after exiting geo-label editing; the reply questions whether the flaky E2E observation is actionable, and the desired destination state remains undecided.

varveAssessment.assessment: The key outcome is explicitly undecided upstream; no Varve behavior was reproduced.

title: More fills button in style panel doesn't select correctly
reason: Reports conflicting default/current selection styling and unexpected state behavior when opening the More fills side panel. No discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Potential inspector regression lead; no Varve reproduction or source inspection was performed.

title: Accessibility gaps in the workspaces UI
reason: Presents an accessibility audit of the tldraw.com workspace switcher, dialogs, member management, and invites using the upstream accessibility tree and live DOM. The only response thanks the author and offers to review a PR; no findings were validated against Varve.

varveAssessment.assessment: The audit targets an upstream workspace service. Any Varve workspace accessibility change requires a separate local audit.

title: Optimize useScreenBounds to reduce getBoundingClientRect calls
reason: Proposes reducing a one-second polling loop in upstream useScreenBounds by relying more on ResizeObserver and event-triggered updates. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: A search found no Varve `useScreenBounds` hook; there is no directly matching polling path established, and no local profiling was performed.

title: Reconsider raster pattern-fill generation: up front, lazy, or vector SVG
reason: Asks whether upstream hash-pattern tiles should be generated at mount, lazily, or represented as SVG. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve pattern fills are document-defined tiles and user-generated recipes rather than an equivalent mandatory multi-zoom mount-time hash-tile pipeline; no analogous startup cost or profile was identified in the searched modules.
